description: This file defines the AccessControl struct within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions on POSIX systems, including changing ownership, setting permissions, and applying these settings based on a NodeId object.

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: A struct providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions, including setting ownership, permissions, and applying these settings based on NodeId.

methods.name: OwnerShip
methods.description: Sets the ownership of a file specified by node to the user and group provided, using POSIX functions.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Sets the permissions of a file specified by node to the modeFlags provided, using POSIX chmod.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a NodeId object, based on its rights and group.
